notes.title: New Demo: Lost and Found Co. adds Cat Cafe & Ducky Room!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Lost and Found Co. at Summer Game Fest Southeast Asia![/b] 🎉[/h3][p]
We’re excited to share the latest gameplay trailer for [b]Lost and Found Co.[/b], released as part of [b]Summer Game Fest Southeast Asia[/b] along with a brand [b]new demo![/b] [/p][previewyoutube="B1wv8zU9jlc;full"][/previewyoutube][p][i]Help Ducky find cute cats in this cozy new Cat Cafe![/i]

What’s new in this demo update:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050414/3c2b5c76913590fe5c86f67002845d9ebee37c75.png"][/img][/p][p]- [b]New Level: Cat Cafe[/b] - Find cute Cats lost in this cozy new Café! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050414/b5771e8aca7c39e590642f22c6ab4621aa5550ff.gif"][/img][/p][p]- [b]Day & Night System[/b] - Revamped in-game lighting systems, giving levels distinct Day and Night looks[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050414/498453cb0904a899da7ca7c530b260d51bbcbc74.gif"][/img][/p][p]- [b]Ducky Room[/b] - Ducky’s personal space is now open! Decorate his personal space however you see fit![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050414/f5b0f09ee64153dcf4f33d2399926ab78427854a.gif"][/img][/p][p]With Ducky Room, you can create a custom space that’s all your own! 
Make your own Ducky Room and share them with us through Steam Forum & Discord!  [/p][p]- [b]Kit Shop[/b] - Spend extra Plum Coins to unlock even more decorations for the Ducky Room[/p][p]- [b]Mysterious Emails[/b] will now appear in your inbox as you progress - who could they be from?[/p][p]- [b]New Side Quests[/b] have been added to previously played levels - revisit favorite levels with fun surprises![/p][p]- Added support for 16:10 screen resolutions 
[/p][p]Our new demo is live as part of Summer Game Fest and run all the way through [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]! [/p][p]Find the cutest cats today in this new cafe!  [/p][p][b]- Ducky[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050414/8779bf7670596dd16d2a08500fb85f148d314ce4.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Lost and Found Co. team[/b][/p]

notes.title: Gamera Games to Publish Lost and Found Co. in China!
notes.content:
[h3]We have fantastic news to share![/h3]

[b]Gamera Games[/b], the super cool and adorable Chinese publisher, is now the official publisher for Lost and Found Co. in Mainland China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Macao! 🌟

We’re all super excited to bring our cozy hidden object adventure to even more players!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050414/7c2387aa1db643da9f1e4564e117713382048017.png[/img]

We've always wanted to bring that sense of nostalgic joy of childhood puzzle books, like ‘Where's Waldo?’ which we loved as a kid, back to life in digital form.

For us, Lost and Found Co. captures that magical wonder we all felt in our childhoods, spending hours searching for hidden objects in puzzle books. Now, this charm is wrapped in a whimsical game world. With Gamera Games, we’re excited for more players to relive those beloved pastimes and explore this cozy and magical world together.

We can't wait for everyone to dive in and uncover all the hidden objects! 

Thank you for being part of this journey with us! 💖

- Ducky
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050414/8779bf7670596dd16d2a08500fb85f148d314ce4.png[/img]
Lost and Found Co. team
